prompts.alley: Wide landscape 16:9 environment painting for a hand-painted side-scrolling 2D urban parkour game. Show the SIDE WALL of a long, dark back alley beside a small Southern US record club at night, seen in strict side elevation from across the narrow lane, like a theater stage set. Flat playable pavement goes horizontally edge-to-edge at 82% image height, with a dark cutaway curb filling the bottom 18%. NO view down the alley or central vanishing point. Across the whole width show multiple dilapidated dark navy, aubergine, and muted umber brick elevations, drain pipes, electrical boxes, worn side doors, an old air conditioner, unlit upper windows, weathered old gig posters without legible text. Rich painterly cel-shaded arcade illustration, bold etched ink lines and textured bricks; readable in low blue moonlight with very deep shadows. Leftmost 65% of the lane is genuinely dark but has visible texture. Sparse warm glow in one high window. In the far right 12% the alley opens to the street, one substantial old-fashioned streetlight casts a warm amber pool ON THE GROUND at the pavement height and a distant glimpse of a teal and pink neon nightclub. Tiny sliver of indigo sky at top. World has no characters, no crates, no props on the walkway, no elevated platforms (game overlays interactive fire escapes), no UI, no labels, no words or borders. The walking surface should be continuous. Canvas 1672x941 or equivalent wide 16:9.
prompts.backpack: Single inventory sprite on a fully transparent background. A collectible limited-run black charcoal canvas streetwear backpack, front three-quarter view, upright, entire bag visible from handle to base. Simple iconic plump backpack silhouette with loop handle and side strap peeking out, one front zipper pocket, antique gold zippers and a small cream woven rectangular patch on the front embroidered with the exact black uppercase initials 'NH'. Warm copper piping and a midnight teal panel highlight give it a readable outline in a dark urban game. Hand-inked painted 2D arcade illustration, thick clean dark contours, rich simple highlights, compact bold graphic shapes readable at 44 pixels. Square 1:1. Centered with 10% transparent margin, no ground or cast shadow, no surrounding objects, no extra lettering, no watermark.
